name: 穢れの外皮の切り離し
prompt:
Create ONE original game-effect editing master, a square canvas on completely transparent background. EXACTLY TWO large isolated curved exterior wrapper strips, laid out side by side with a wide transparent gutter between them. Left strip is a broad open C shape opening to the right; right strip is a broad reverse C shape opening to the left. Blunt softly rounded endpoints, solid broad clean silhouettes. Each stays within its half of the canvas with generous clear margins, about twice as tall as wide. They are two detached OUTER COVERINGS, never a character. No head, no face, no eyes, no body, no limb, no clothing on a person, no hair, no blade, no text, no floor, no cast shadow. No small particles, no grain, no glitter, no stars, no thin threads, no scallops, no scales, no complicated repeated folds. The space between and inside the open curves must be transparent. Single smooth painted folds/shading, readable at64px, opaque material interior with clean anti-aliased edge. These same two shapes will be rigidly moved outward and gently upward, then reduced into quiet disappearance after detaching. Do not depict an explosion or harm to a body. Use the reference only for its muted slate-charcoal/lavender outer haze palette and soft anime game shading; DO NOT draw any of the creature or its eyes. Both strips are broad smooth CURLS OF DULL EXTERIOR HAZE, muted gray-violet outside and one restrained lighter slate-blue fold. Keep them dull and quiet, no bright purple flames, no hard metal bevel, no armored plate. A soft but well-defined curled exterior film made of three broad tonal zones, no wispy fuzzy fringe. This is for ordinary chapters only, where an imposed gray crust detaches; do not portray a person's true black color being erased. 「髪は全て透過せず、下位レイヤーを描写しない。髪の不透明度は100％とする」
「intricate textures（複雑な質感）の要素は抑えめにし、過剰な微細描写、エッジノイズ、粒状のきらめき、鱗状の模様、等間隔に繰り返す細かな波打ちを避け、全体になめらかで清潔感のある質感を強調してください。」

No vivid purple or fluorescent blue outline. Remove every stray colored speck, grain, glitter, jagged protrusion, fuzzy fringe and halo around both silhouettes and from all transparent space. Two smooth broad opaque forms with clean anti-aliased edges, no tiny disconnected parts. Do not add any character, eyes, face, blade, particle, border or extra strip. Fully transparent background. 「髪は全て透過せず、下位レイヤーを描写しない。髪の不透明度は100％とする」
